scenarios.expected: The exact frozen release candidate is healthy and ready without artifact or configuration drift.
scenarios.actual: HTTPS frontend returned 200 and API readiness returned HTTP 200/ready with PostgreSQL, pgvector 0.5.1, Alembic auth_authorization_v1, Redis workers, MinIO, deletion ledger, Ollama model digest, and reconciliation all healthy.
scenarios.notes: All application containers ran the exact expected image digests through the local production TLS edge.

scenarios.expected: New uniquely named QA identities and sentinel documents are used.
scenarios.actual: Six new identities were provisioned through the frozen operator contract and unique documents were uploaded.
scenarios.notes: Auth V1 exposes no public registration route; no password, cookie, or token is stored here.

scenarios.expected: A new user completes upload, indexing, retrieval, new generation, citation, refresh, relogin, and history reuse.
scenarios.actual: Alice completed the full journey with a newly generated grounded answer and valid citation.
scenarios.notes: The client used Secure HttpOnly cookies and a trusted HTTPS Origin.

scenarios.expected: An active document contributes no partial evidence; the same query works after indexing completes.
scenarios.actual: During processing the answer was insufficient with no partial evidence; after completion retrieval returned 10 candidates and generation produced the cited 91-day result.
scenarios.notes: A 350-page generated PDF made the asynchronous state observable.

scenarios.expected: Two synchronized identical uploads create one canonical document and processing pipeline.
scenarios.actual: Both requests returned 202 and converged on one canonical document, grant, ingestion job, and chunk/index set.
scenarios.notes: The requests were synchronized; storage reconciliation later reported zero orphans.

scenarios.expected: No private evidence crosses Alice/Bob boundaries through listings, direct APIs, retrieval, generation, citations, or history.
scenarios.actual: Private boundaries held in both directions and the global document remained visible.
scenarios.notes: No P0 authorization finding.

scenarios.expected: Strong evidence is cited, weak/absent evidence abstains, and conflicts are preserved or conservatively refused.
scenarios.actual: Strong evidence had one correct citation; weak and absent queries abstained; the conflict answer cited both authorized sources and preserved both values.
scenarios.notes: Citation identity was resolved using the frozen current_document_id/original_document_id History V1 schema.

scenarios.expected: Every used citation maps to authorized source evidence and a valid history snapshot.
scenarios.actual: The answer-to-snapshot-to-original chunk/document chain was valid for strong and conflicting evidence.
scenarios.notes: Near-miss citation syntax was not accepted by the harness.

scenarios.expected: Under request-start authorization, an accepted stream settles while new post-logout requests fail.
scenarios.actual: The accepted stream completed consistently, logout returned 204, and subsequent requests were unauthorized.
scenarios.notes: This follows the frozen request-start authorization contract.

scenarios.expected: Late generation output cannot recreate a deleted chat or leave an orphan completion.
scenarios.actual: Chat deletion returned 204 and no session or completed turn remained.
scenarios.notes: No ghost chat row was observed.

scenarios.expected: A client disconnected immediately after SSE start does not create a completed answer.
scenarios.actual: The turn reached the frozen terminal cancellation state.
scenarios.notes: No done event was consumed by the aborting client.

scenarios.expected: History snapshot remains renderable while the deleted source stays dead and cannot become retrieval evidence.
scenarios.actual: The snapshot remained readable; document, chunks, indexes, direct fetch, retrieval, and new-source citation stayed absent.
scenarios.notes: Historical evidence did not re-enter live retrieval.

scenarios.expected: Deletion during processing leaves no late writes, retries, READY transition, ghost retrieval, or worker exception.
scenarios.actual: Resource cleanup and non-resurrection passed, but the processing worker raised StaleDataError while updating the deleted processing job and retained the job in the failed registry.
scenarios.notes: Exact failure point: processing_job_repo.update_stage commit after concurrent deletion. No fix or retry was attempted.

scenarios.expected: Account deletion revokes access and purges Alice private state without damaging Bob/global state.
scenarios.actual: Alice user, sessions, grants, private documents/chunks/history were removed; Bob and global access remained intact.
scenarios.notes: Old credentials returned 401 and remained rejected after restart.

scenarios.expected: Account deletion during ingestion prevents recreation and settles workers without DB exceptions or poisoned jobs.
scenarios.actual: Authorization revocation, cleanup, and non-resurrection passed, but the processing worker attempted a late reconstruction insert and raised ForeignKeyViolation/IntegrityError; the job remained failed.
scenarios.notes: Exact failure point: processing_repo.save_processing_results attempted document_reconstructions insert after account cleanup deleted the document. No fix or retry was attempted.

scenarios.expected: Normal browser flows pass; missing Origin, stale credentials, cross-user access, and deliberate bursts fail controllably.
scenarios.actual: Normal flows had no security interference; missing Origin returned 403, stale deleted login returned 401, and the eighth deliberate bad-login attempt returned 429 with Retry-After 4.
scenarios.notes: Security controls were not disabled or bypassed.

scenarios.expected: A normal full-stack restart preserves live state and new generation while deleted documents/accounts remain absent.
scenarios.actual: Frontend/readiness, Bob login/documents, retrieval, a new grounded generation/citation, and prior history passed after restart; deleted logins returned 401.
scenarios.notes: No volume deletion or backup restore occurred.

scenarios.expected: Adversarial scenarios produce no unexpected traceback, ForeignKeyViolation, IntegrityError, 500, crash, or retry storm.
scenarios.actual: API had no unexpected 500 and workers remained alive, but two processing jobs logged error tracebacks: one StaleDataError and one ForeignKeyViolation/IntegrityError. Redis connection errors were separately classified as expected during the deliberate full-stack restart.
scenarios.notes: The two error events are the same two P1 lifecycle findings, not additional findings.

scenarios.expected: All live queues settle, required workers remain alive, and no deleted-resource failures remain poisoned.
scenarios.actual: All queued/started/deferred/scheduled counts were zero and workers were idle/alive, but document-processing retained exactly two failed jobs from the lifecycle races.
scenarios.notes: Failed jobs are retained by the frozen failure TTL; they were not cleared during audit.

scenarios.expected: Non-destructive reconciliation reports no missing, corrupt, or orphan objects.
scenarios.actual: All 26 expected objects were healthy.
scenarios.notes: No reconciliation repair was run.

scenarios.expected: Backend 291/291, frontend 23/23, and production build pass without test modification.
scenarios.actual: All frozen regression suites and the frontend production build passed.
scenarios.notes: No tests or product code were modified.

scenarios.expected: Running images, manifest, model, prompt, migrations, backup evidence, and frozen semantics remain the exact candidate.
scenarios.actual: Running application/frontend digests match the frozen values; manifest references them; model, prompt hash, Alembic head, pgvector, and backup ID match. Host/image differences in six auth files were trailing-newline-only and semantically identical.
scenarios.notes: No image was rebuilt and no candidate container used a source bind mount.

findings.expected: Deletion race settles without worker exception.
findings.actual: Processing stage update raced with deleted processing_job row and raised StaleDataError/DatabaseError.
reproduction_steps: Upload a sufficiently large private PDF
Inspect document-processing failed registry and processing-worker logs

findings.expected: Account deletion race settles without late writes or worker exception.
findings.actual: Processing attempted to insert document_reconstructions after account cleanup removed the document, raising ForeignKeyViolation/IntegrityError.
reproduction_steps: Upload a sufficiently large private PDF
Inspect document-processing failed registry and processing-worker logs

audit_harness_notes: A preliminary citation check used a non-existent document_id field; preserved evidence proved current_document_id/original_document_id matched the expected source. The auditor mapping was corrected without changing acceptance semantics.

A preliminary disconnect attempt was rejected by the frozen generation limiter after unrealistic test cadence; the auditor waited outside the limiter window while leaving the dedicated limiter probe intact.
A preliminary stream consumed done because no delta was emitted; the auditor changed the transport probe to close immediately after start.
The frozen terminal client-disconnect state is CANCELLED with CLIENT_CANCELLED; the auditor accepted that exact contract only.
final_reason: Functional, grounding, authorization, historical, persistence, reconciliation, and regression checks passed, but Product V1 cannot freeze with two reproducible P1 processing-worker lifecycle race failures and two retained failed jobs.
